items.title: Harold Dejan Interview, 1960-10-14
items.q: Did anybody ever tell you about the trumpet player around him by the name of Kimball?

ctx.x: That's beyond me, no. Something like that, no, that went on, I forget what it is. No, I don't remember that. We'll find somebody on, tell us someday.

Getting back to that, when I first went to the opera house, I went with, it was Paul Moyer, and the Sam Hopkins playing piano. I told him I wasn't gonna rest him for a couple of weeks, but right with the Silver Slipper, was just making so much money, just making, oh, I guess, $40, $50, $90, $90, $10. Oh, yeah, yeah, yeah. And when I went to the opera house, the scale was $6. And when I stayed there, and first night I went there, a man asked me, he said, can you read? I said, read a little. He said, I got this…
Yeah, I've heard, I don't know much about him, but I've heard the name. He's heard the trumpet player.
